summary: Mploy Associates is talent Focused Consultancy in Data, Finance, Analytics, and IT, founded in 2018. Type: startup / scale-up. About 56 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 7 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

culture.text: Small firm of about 56 people (founded 2018); consultants work at clients like ING, Rabobank and NN and spend at least one day a week at the Mploy office.
10% of working hours go to skill development, through a 24-month programme for junior consultants.
Staff often studied economics, finance or international business at UvA, VU, Groningen or Utrecht.

open.text: Mploy Associates International B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Says it is still expanding, working only for clients in the Dutch top-200.

worth_knowing.text: Recognised as a Great Place To Work since 2023.
